TechPowerUp's review of the ASUS TUF Gaming RTX 5070 Ti OC found its all-metal cooler 'built like a tank'. In testing the card ran whisper-quiet at full load on the Quiet BIOS and very cool on the default BIOS. The main drawback is the $1,000 price, a 33% premium over NVIDIA's $750 baseline.

The reviewer notes the RTX 5070 Ti is marketed at 1440p but should handle native 4K if you tune game settings or use DLSS. Its memory is a big step up from the 4070 Ti: 16 GB vs 12 GB, a 256-bit bus vs 192-bit, and 28 Gbps GDDR7, giving 896 GB/s, about 77% more bandwidth.

A commenter was unimpressed by the leaked RTX 5070 Ti specs, noting the 4070 Ti Super already had 16GB of 21Gbps GDDR6X and 8448 CUDA cores. Against that, 28Gbps memory and 8960 cores 'sounds... fine', and they said value will depend on price.
